final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS cnt FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / avg_c.a AS ratio FROM counts c, avg_c ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
